video_goal: Demonstrate the visual steps to securely install a Diono Radian 3R car seat using SuperLATCH in a tight 3-across vehicle back seat configuration.
single_prompt: A wide shot pans across a well-lit vehicle back seat featuring grey upholstery and natural daylight streaming through the car windows, showing two installed car seats with a narrow empty space in the middle. Hands unfold the bottom base of the narrow profile Diono Radian 3R car seat with a steel core frame and red SuperLATCH connectors until it clicks into its rigid L-shape. From an over-the-shoulder view, hands lower the narrow profile Diono Radian 3R car seat with a steel core frame and red SuperLATCH connectors directly into the tight middle space between the two existing car seats. In a close-up, fingers unclip the SuperLATCH connectors with red release buttons from the storage slots on the back of the seat. A medium close-up shows hands threading the SuperLATCH strap through the side opening of the forward-facing belt path. An extreme close-up captures a hand pushing the metal SuperLATCH connector directly onto the vehicle's lower anchor bar deep in the seat bight, followed by the opposite hand pushing the second connector onto the other anchor bar. In a medium shot, a hand pushes down heavily on the seat pan while the other hand pulls the tightening strap straight up. A close-up shows hands gripping the side of the seat at the belt path and pushing it left and right, showing minimal movement. From an over-the-shoulder view, hands toss the top tether strap with a metal hook over the top of the vehicle seat headrest. A close-up reveals fingers snapping the top tether hook onto the metal anchor bracket on the back of the vehicle seat, and then a hand pulls the loose tail of the top tether strap downwards until it becomes completely taut. Finally, the camera slowly zooms out to a wide shot showing the narrow profile Diono Radian 3R car seat with a steel core frame and red SuperLATCH connectors sitting flush and secure in a complete 3-across car seat setup inside a well-lit vehicle back seat featuring grey upholstery and natural daylight streaming through the car windows.
